/// Path is relative to the generated function body, not text or image row IDs.
/// Every traversed source edge receives a separate occurrence, even for a DAG.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize)]
pub struct SourceOccurrence {
    pub action_index: usize,
    pub statement_index: usize,
    pub expression: Option<ExprId>,
    pub body_path: Vec<usize>,
    pub node_kind: String,
    pub source_expression: Option<CoreExpr>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize)]
pub struct ScalarActionReport {
    pub action_index: usize,
    pub action: String,
    pub inputs: Vec<InputSite>,
    pub lets: Vec<LetSite>,
    pub emit: EmitSite,
    /// Body preorder, with child positions matching ProgramImage's AST locators.
    pub occurrences: Vec<SourceOccurrence>,
    pub return_type: crate::Type,
    pub generated_function_name: String,
    pub symbol_domain: String,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct ScalarActionMap {
    pub function: Function,
    pub report: ScalarActionReport,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize)]
#[serde(tag = "status", rename_all = "kebab-case")]
pub enum ActionProjection {

    Unsupported { action_index: usize, action: String, diagnostic: ProjectionDiagnostic },
}

claims.statement: Public prepare_scalar_action(&CoreProgram,action_index)->Result<ScalarActionMap,ProjectionDiagnostic> calls Core validate,starts a local occurrence counter,and calls prepare_validated_action.

prepare_validated_action checks action index,Core LANGUAGE/SEMANTICS,and empty states/assets. It collects Lets before an Emit,accepts an Emit only at final statement position,and returns diagnostic metadata for other statement shapes or absent final Emit. No financial/program acceptance judgment is inferred.

The adapter maps input parameter declarations and wraps reversed mapped Lets into a typed Function with action name; report records inputs/lets/emit/occurrences/return type and a typed-host-symbols label. map_expression handles literal/name/not and Add/Sub/Mul/Eq/Lt branches; other binary operations and liability reads return local diagnostics.

Bounded API declares HostObservationBounds with explicit action/expression/statement/argument/occurrence/nesting/stack/record/slot fields; HostMeasure,HostObservationRefusal,HostExtent and BoundedSourceObservation store typed metadata and snapshots/records. No Default derive appears on these displayed bounds.

Public observe_scalar_action(&CoreProgram,action_index,&[SherlockValue],initial_fuel,bounds)->Result<BoundedSourceObservation,HostObservationRefusal> checks source shape/arguments/action,then calls Core validate before its count pass and local bounds.

Bounded source performs literal forward size/depth counting,occurrence/nesting/step/retained-slot comparisons and checked/saturating arithmetic before prepare_scalar_action. These are source operations only; count/resource/native-stack sufficiency is not assessed.

After preparation,observe_scalar_action checks generated signature/body extents,constructs one Expr::Call containing literal scalar arguments,constructs Sherlock Program,then calls Machine::new,snapshot,run_steps,snapshot and step. Pending returns UnpublishedOutcome; otherwise it returns BoundedSourceObservation with QUALIFICATION.

claims.statement: CLI commands::run routes Command::Compile to compile::run. compile::run checks a literal moriarty/2 route first and calls backend stage::compile_staged there; its other branch parses Core source then calls backend source_projection::compile_reported. These are inspected non-test command source calls.

In the nonstaged CLI branch,reported.artifact is taken as artifact; reported.source_projection is serialized with source_hash and published separately as source-projection.json. publish_artifact writes circuit.zkir values and artifact.json from Artifact. This is source consumer placement,not evidence that files were generated.

A separate models/sherlock/reference source producer imports observe_scalar_action,parses fixed included Core specimens in prepare,and calls observe_scalar_action(source,0,arguments,fuel,BOUNDS) from its observe function. It has a standalone main that loops fixed inputs/fuels. This is a non-test diagnostic source caller,not an observed installed/compiler/ledger entry.

The inspected non-test command→compile_reported→source_projection_report edge defeats a blanket claim that these public adapters have no production source caller. Its returned projection is separate metadata after Artifact construction; this does not establish Sherlock-to-Cardano compilation,semantic correspondence or runtime behavior.
